verdict.rationale: Bland's docs say agents can connect to any HTTP endpoint, connect external APIs and take live actions during phone calls, and execute webhooks at any point in a pathway conversation. That covers the core mid-call API-calling capability. However, nothing in the evidence shows the agent speaking the returned result, or handling latency to avoid dead air (filler speech, async handling). missing for 10: evidence that API results are voiced back to the caller, latency/dead-air mitigation during tool calls, custom (non-HTTP) function support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can call external APIs and custom functions mid-conversation and speak the result without awkward dead air

citations.quote: The API integration lets you connect your AI agent to any HTTP endpoint.
Connect external APIs and take live actions during phone calls.
Execute webhooks at any point during the conversation
